items.title: Define the LENS_TO_LANE mapping (six real review lanes per §4.2) + the lane type, in core/adversarial-review-lens-runner.ts
items.context: New module importing S0 (core/adversarial-review.js: LensId, CANONICAL_LENS_SET, Finding). LENS_TO_LANE: Record<LensId, lane> exactly per §4.2 (concept/scope->lattice-review-concept, code-quality->lattice-review-quality, behavior/correctness->lattice-review-behavior, test-coverage->lattice-review-test-coverage, crash-safety/edge->lattice-review-behavior, docs-consistency->lattice-review-docs). The lane type must be the six real review_run_start lanes; pin correctness by cross-checking against review-run.ts REVIEW_RUN_LANES (import it, or assert in the smoke). Every mapped lane must be a real lane.

happy.desc: LENS_TO_LANE has exactly 6 entries, one per LENS_IDS member, with mapped lanes matching spec section 4.2 table (concept/scope->lattice-review-concept, code-quality->lattice-review-quality, behavior/correctness->lattice-review-behavior, test-coverage->lattice-review-test-coverage, crash-safety/edge->lattice-review-behavior, docs-consistency->lattice-review-docs) -> all 6 mappings present and correct; WHY: covers the fundamental mapping correctness that every downstream function depends on

Every value in LENS_TO_LANE is a member of REVIEW_RUN_LANES (imported from core/review-run.ts) -> subset assertion passes; WHY: pins the mapping to reality so a lane rename or removal in review-run.ts is immediately caught

The lane type exported from the module is the union of exactly the six real review_run_start lanes (matches ReviewRunLane from review-run.ts) -> type-level and runtime agreement; WHY: ensures no seventh/phantom lane can be assigned

edge.desc: LENS_TO_LANE has two lenses (behavior/correctness and crash-safety/edge) both mapping to lattice-review-behavior -> both entries present, distinct keys, same value, no collision or overwrite; WHY: the two-to-one mapping is the trickiest part of the table and a naive Set-based uniqueness check would wrongly reject it

LENS_IDS contains slash-form ids (concept/scope, behavior/correctness, crash-safety/edge) used as object keys -> Record lookup by slash-form string succeeds without encoding/escaping; WHY: slash in key is an unusual pattern that could break naive property access

adversarial.desc: If a hypothetical 7th lane were added to REVIEW_RUN_LANES but NOT to LENS_TO_LANE, the subset assertion still passes (LENS_TO_LANE values are a subset, not an exact match) -> no false failure; WHY: verifies the assertion direction is subset-of not equals, which is the correct contract (lattice-review-channel exists in REVIEW_RUN_LANES but is not used by any lens)

If REVIEW_RUN_LANES were to remove lattice-review-behavior, the subset assertion fails because two lenses (behavior/correctness + crash-safety/edge) map to it -> immediate detection of lane drift; WHY: this is the highest-risk drift scenario since two lenses share the lane

items.title: buildLensRunPlan(change, lensSet) -> one INDEPENDENT LensRunRequest per lens (no cross-lens data)
items.context: LensRunRequest = {lensId: LensId, lane, change: string} (the isolated input a lens gets). buildLensRunPlan(change, lensSet=CANONICAL_LENS_SET) returns one request per lens in the (possibly-subset) set, each carrying ONLY the change + its mapped lane — NEVER another lens's findings/outputs (independence, §2.1). Accepts a subset lens set (task-tunable). No behavior beyond plan construction.

items.title: runLenses(change, lensSet, runLens) applies the INJECTED per-lens executor + collects per-lane raw Finding[]; collectRawFindings aggregator
items.context: LensRunResult = {lensId, lane, findings: Finding[]} (findings=[] means PASS). runLenses(change, lensSet, runLens: (req: LensRunRequest) => Finding[]) builds the plan, applies the injected runLens to EACH request independently (runLens is the seam for the real review agent; harness/main-agent supplied at MVP), and returns LensRunResult[]. collectRawFindings(results) flattens to Finding[] (+ optionally findingsByLane). Independence enforced: runLens only ever receives a single lens's request, never another's result.

items.title: Hermetic smoke with a FAKE runLens proving mapping + independence + aggregation; register in lattice.config.json
items.context: New packages/main/src/tasks/adversarial-review-lens-runner-smoke.ts (check+counter pattern). Assert: every value of LENS_TO_LANE is in the real six-lane set (import REVIEW_RUN_LANES from core/review-run.js and assert subset — this PINS the mapping to reality); buildLensRunPlan over CANONICAL_LENS_SET yields 6 requests, one per lens, each with the right mapped lane and carrying only {lensId,lane,change} (no findings field / no cross-lens data); a SUBSET lens set yields only those requests; runLenses with a fake runLens (returns a planted Finding for one lens, [] for others) yields the right LensRunResult[] with findings grouped by lens/lane and PASS lenses empty; collectRawFindings flattens correctly. Register node packages/main/dist/tasks/adversarial-review-lens-runner-smoke.js in lattice.config.json validate.commands.
